meta.title: Flight Log (Demo)
meta.description: A private flight log and statistics app for WordPress. Pre-loaded with two years of sample flights so you can explore the dashboard, statistics and filters right away.
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:

require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

	return;
}

}
